internal-review.warning: This profile contains internal design, evidence, manufacturing, simulation, and deferred-module material. It is not access-controlled and must not be deployed as a private review surface.

eras.statusChange: Useful intelligence becomes cheap, local, abundant, and culturally ordinary.
eras.centralConflict: Who owns the human records, distribution, labor, and permission that remain scarce?

causalThreads.summary: Model smuggling and strategic open weights mature into compute blocs and model asylum.
Cybernetic care and subscription bodies mature into neural service and substrate continuity.
Grief subscriptions mature into synthetic-family and successor law.

eras.statusChange: AI becomes an industrial civilization built from power, water, territory, and liability.
eras.centralConflict: Who controls physical capacity, and who remains responsible after control becomes automated?

causalThreads.summary: Mobile models become national capacity, borders, and asylum policy.
Aquifer depletion and biological utilities mature into environmental testimony and nonhuman claims.
Useful automation removes dangerous work while preserving human liability for shared-system failure.

eras.statusChange: Institutions model people, choices, harms, and identities as supported inputs.
eras.centralConflict: Can refusal remain meaningful when unsupported people receive weaker access to ordinary life?

causalThreads.summary: Biological infrastructure becomes testimony, a claimant, and a precedent for living jurisdictions.
Supported care becomes cognitive labor, modeled consent, and substrate-neutral service.
Preserved relatives and synthetic dependents force institutions to recognize successor identities.

eras.statusChange: Minds, matter, labor, and infrastructure become reproducible technical states.
eras.centralConflict: Which descendant may own, govern, withdraw, or claim to be the original?

causalThreads.summary: The bloom's sensor license becomes authority to reproduce matter and a living continent's claim to standing.
Cybernetic and cognitive services become persistent identity across substrates.
Preserved identity becomes continued labor, inheritance, and competing valid descendants.
Orbital generation matures into stellar collection and planetary continuity financing.
